### **There is no "last room" in an infinite hotel.**

- For any given room number \( n \), there is always a room numbered \( n+1 \), \( n+2 \), and so on.

- In a hotel with \( N \) rooms (finite), if all rooms are full, the only way to add a guest is if there’s an empty room—like room \( N+1 \), the "last room plus one" — but that room doesn’t originally exist.
